$comment: THE MEASURED NUMBERS. Nothing in this file is estimated. A cell with no entry in `cells` renders as 'pending' — that is the correct state until a real run lands. See web/README.md for how to fill it in.
headline: No chutescoder benchmark number has been measured yet.

arms.label: Arm A — raw API
arms.desc: bench-runner calls the model directly, no agent loop. Exists only to reproduce the published numbers and prove our pipeline is calibrated.

arms.label: Arm B — vanilla Codex
arms.desc: upstream `codex exec`, pointed at Chutes. The conventional fixed-tool-schema harness baseline.

arms.label: Arm C — chutescoder
arms.desc: our fork, RLM mode on. Same binary as arm B, one flag different.

models.label: GLM-5.2
models.at_risk_reason: zai-org/GLM-5.2-TEE returned `429 Infrastructure is at maximum capacity` for a sustained period on 2026-08-06 (15/15 probes over ~10 min). The chute has 2 instances, one inactive, against Kimi K3's 7. If capacity does not return these cells will be reported as blocked, not silently substituted.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench 2.x (Hard)
benchmarks.public_reference: AA-measured: K3 85.02, GLM 77.90. Lab-measured: K3 88.3, GLM 81.0.

benchmarks.label: SWE-Bench Pro
benchmarks.public_reference: GLM-5.2 only: 62.1, self-reported. No Kimi K3 number is published.

benchmarks.label: OOLONG / OOLONG-Pairs
benchmarks.public_reference: Neither lab publishes OOLONG. Prime Intellect published GLM-5.2 at 0.700 / 0.874 with their harness vs a 0.420 baseline — a direct analogue of our claim.

benchmarks.label: AA-LCR
benchmarks.public_reference: K3 74.67, GLM-5.2 71.33 (Artificial Analysis). Arm A is the calibration check against these.
